subject.title: feat(plugins): add Control UI entry points

question: Should OpenClaw add `registerControlUiEntryPoint` as a separate public plugin UI API, or fold its launch-token behavior into the existing `surface: "tab"` descriptor seam?
rationale: This is a durable plugin SDK, Gateway protocol, and browser-security contract; automation can identify unsafe fallbacks, but maintainers must choose the permanent API and isolation model before third-party plugins depend on it.

options.title: Fold Into Tab Descriptor
options.body: Extend the existing plugin tab descriptor contract with token launch behavior, keep plugin pages sandboxed, and avoid a parallel public API.

options.title: Approve Separate API After Hardening
options.body: Keep `registerControlUiEntryPoint`, but require iframe-only opaque sandboxing, fail-closed launch errors, docs, and exact-head proof before merge.

options.title: Pause For RFC Consolidation
options.body: Leave this PR open but do not merge until the native plugin page issue and broader contribution-slot RFC settle the API shape.

recommendation.title: Fold Into Tab Descriptor
recommendation.body: Extend the existing plugin tab descriptor contract with token launch behavior, keep plugin pages sandboxed, and avoid a parallel public API.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the generic host-hook foundation and the broader Control UI contribution-slot RFC, so their history best matches the API-shape decision.
